sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
MOUSE on the green block deleted it! Green nodes went from 7 → 6. The top-left block (rows 1-5, cols 13-16) disappeared, and in the image a sky-colored hole (a small sky square) is visible at its position. So MOUSE = click to delete/destroy a green block!
So the goal is: delete all 7 green blocks. Each MOUSE click on a green block deletes it. Timer decreases with each action.
Wait, but does the player's position matter? The player is at rows 37-40, and the block I clicked was at rows 1-5. The click worked from a distance. So the player might be irrelevant, or the player might be a "cursor" that moves with LEFT/RIGHT... hmm. But the click on the top-left block worked even though the player is far away. So MOUSE directly deletes the block.
But wait — maybe the block only gets deleted if the player is "aligned" with it? The player is at cols 20-22, and the block I deleted was at cols 13-16. Not aligned. So no alignment needed.
So the solution: click each of the remaining 6 green blocks with MOUSE. Remaining blocks:
1. rows 1-5, cols 19-23 (top center)
2. rows 1-5, cols 25-29 (top right)
3. rows 13-17, cols 31-35 (middle)
4. rows 13-17, cols 37-41
5. rows 13-17, cols 43-47
6. rows 13-17, cols 49-53
Click the center of each: (3, 21), (3, 27), (15, 33), (15, 39), (15, 45), (15, 51).
But wait — do I need to be careful about whether the click has to be on a green pixel? I clicked (3,14) and it worked. Let me batch-execute all 6 clicks at once and check the result. If the level completes, great.
But wait — is deleting the green blocks the goal, or does something else happen (e.g., blocks fall, and the player has to collect them)? The reward was 0.0, and the level didn't complete after one deletion. Probably the level completes when all 7 are gone. Let me batch-execute the remaining 6 clicks.

- MOUSE on a green block DELETES it (7→6; clicked block's spot turned sky). Goal = remove all green blocks before timer (white bar) empties.
- Player position irrelevant to clicking. Remaining blocks: (rows1–5: cols19–23, 25–29) and (rows13–17: cols31–35, 37–41, 43–47, 49–53).
Plan: batch-click all 6 remaining block centers.
